{{Quote|Pardon my ignorance&mdash;I'm not an artist, and I'm not exactly familiar with the genre&mdash;but couldn't you substitute something for a piece of Adegan? Another energy source? Marilite, maybe, or pressure-treated halurium grains?|Jax Pavan, to Baron Vlaçan Umber|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
'''Marilite''' was a type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] that could be used as an energy source. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] for [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were sometimes made using marilite, which was also used in the construction of other weapon components. Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] named [[Jax Pavan]] hoped to get a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] for building a lightsaber from one of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Vlaçan Umber]]'s [[Ves Volette]] [[light sculpture]]s, thinking that the sculpture could be powered with marilite. However, Baron Umber adamantly refused Pavan's request due to the fact that a light sculpture would be destroyed if its [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] was removed.

==Properties==
Marilite was a type of [[Color/Legends|dark gray]]-colored [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]]<ref name="Treasure Hunting" /> that could be used as an energy source.<ref name="Shadows" />

==History==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="TOR" /> marilite was used to make [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] for [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], as well as to construct other weapon components.<ref name="Artifice" /> During that time, marilite gemstones could sell for fifteen [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each.<ref name="TOR" />

Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jax Pavan]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-turned-[[Detective/Legends|investigator]], went to question [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Vlaçan Umber]] at the baron's [[Vlaçan Umber's apartment|apartment]] in the [[Manarai Hills]] district of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] regarding the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of the [[light sculptor]] [[Ves Volette]]. When Pavan arrived at the baron's home, his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companion, [[I-5YQ]], noticed that the baron's Ves Volette [[light sculpture]]s contained [[compressed energy crystal]]s similar to [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|those]] used in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], a traditional [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] weapon that Pavan was trying to construct. Hoping to obtain one of the crystals, Pavan asked for one and suggested that the baron could replace one of the sculpture's crystals with another energy source such as marilite or pressure-treated [[halurium]] grains. However, the baron was shocked by the request and refused on the grounds that removing the crystal would destroy the sculpture.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
Marilite was first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Shadows" /> Marilite first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]<ref name="TOR" /> as a grade-two gemstone that players with the treasure [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] crew skill can receive by sending their companions on missions. The treasure hunting missions that can have marilite as a reward are<ref name="Treasure Hunting" /> "Going Once&hellip;,"<ref name="Going Once">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Going Once&hellip;}}</ref> "Map or Trap?,"<ref name="Map or Trap?">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Map or Trap?}}</ref> "Pugilism,"<ref name="Pugilism">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Pugilism}}</ref> "Retrieve This,"<ref name="Retrieve This">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Retrieve This}}</ref> "Riddled by Riddles,"<ref name="Riddled by Riddles">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Riddled by Riddles}}</ref> "Stolen Trophy,"<ref name="Stolen Trophy">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Stolen Trophy}}</ref> and "Unclaimed Inheritance."<ref name="Unclaimed Inheritance">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Unclaimed Inheritance}}</ref>

In the game, marilite is used to construct higher-quality, low-level weapon upgrades, crystals, and lightsabers using the Artifice crew skill. Marilite's properties in ''The Old Republic'' potentially conflict with information provided in ''Street of Shadows'', given that the gemstone can be used to construct a lightsaber crystal in the game,<ref name="Artifice" /> while in the novel Jax Pavan wanted to trade marilite for a crystal that could be used in constructing a lightsaber.<ref name="Shadows" />
